tonight.headline: 51% — and Golden is still on your bench
body: Bad news first: Tuten's ankle is not settled (Coen: limited practice, a call 'towards the end of the week'). Taylor gets Anthony Richardson's first start. Jacobs had finger surgery and is expected to miss two to three weeks (NBC 24 Nov). You are 3-8.

You project 126.2 to 123.9. The 2.7-point Golden swap has not been made: Golden is still on your bench and kicks off Wednesday 19:00 CDMX. JuiceJam's Kenneth Walker III (21.4) returned to a limited practice on Tuesday, his first since Week 10. If they start him, they gain about 7 to 11.
